semantic_findings.assessment: A1 requires only typed fields, positive width, start<=end and the two specified fill modes; no event/list/integer/Unicode bounds introduced.
D1 and O2 sort distinct group names from all events by Unicode scalar-codepoint order, including exclusively out-of-range or null events.
D1 and O3 enumerate all natural k with start+k*width<end, clip the half-open upper boundary at end, and emit no buckets for start=end.
D1 and O4 retain occurrence multiplicity, ignore null values in both count and sum, and use exact unbounded integer sums.
O5 selects only the greatest strictly earlier nonempty bucket in the same group, initializes absent state, never resets on emptiness, treats zero as present and excludes pre-start seeding.
O6 requires exact group-major/bucket-increasing list equality with all specified fields; empty group enumeration or empty interval yields no rows.
O7 retains both original exact result lists and additionally requires full universal aggregation; examples are not substituted for functional correctness.
All nine required source-policy identities remain canonical program.vscore.json solve/arity1 with all seven closed properties. O1-O7 retain universal value requirements; only I1/S1 are source-only.
No additional program obligation about supervisor metadata, registry inspection, trust configuration or staged verification was injected. All eleven IDs match original metadata.
